# commander_classic_software_license (Resource)

Creates and manages a Keeper **software license** record (`softwareLicense`) in the vault.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "commander_classic_software_license" "example" {
  title = "my metron software record"

  software_license_key = "132456789807867564331423565"
  expiration_date      = "2026-05-20"
  date_active          = "2026-07-09"

  notes           = "this is test record"
  folder_location = "_REPLACE_WITH_FOLDER_PATH_OR_UID_"

  share = {
    "alice@example.com" = {
      can_share = true
      can_edit  = true
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `title` (String) Record title.

### Optional

- `custom` (Attributes List) Manage custom fields for the record. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom))
- `date_active` (String) **Date value** (`YYYY-MM-DD`).
- `expiration_date` (String) **Date value** (`YYYY-MM-DD`).
- `folder_location` (String) Folder `path` or `UID` where the record is to be stored.
- `notes` (String) Manage note for the record.
- `share` (Attributes Map) Mapping of share permissions for this record. Each map **key** is a **user email**; each **value** is an object with `can_share` and `can_edit` booleans. The owner is implicit and never present in this map; the API rejects owner entries. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--share))
- `software_license_key` (String, Sensitive) **Software license key**.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier (UID) of the vault record.

<a id="nestedatt--custom"></a>
### Nested Schema for `custom`

Required:

- `label` (String) Field label.
- `type` (String) Keeper field type (e.g. `text`, `email`, `secret`, `phone`, `name`, `date`).
- `value` (String) Field value; for complex types use `jsonencode(JSON)` matching the [Keeper field schema](https://docs.keeper.io/en/keeperpam/secrets-manager/about/field-record-types).

Optional:

- `sensitive` (Boolean) Whether to mark the value as sensitive in Terraform state display.


<a id="nestedatt--share"></a>
### Nested Schema for `share`

Optional:

- `can_edit` (Boolean) Allow the user to edit this record. Defaults to `false`.
- `can_share` (Boolean) Allow the user to re-share this record with other users. Defaults to `false`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import commander_classic_software_license.example _REPLACE_WITH_RECORD_UID_
```
